facts.claim: The native language teaching in Mercara and the districts involved learning alphabets, memorizing multiplication tables, and later reading and writing petitions.
facts.quote: The teaching of the native languages, Hindustani at Mercara, and Canarese in the districts, consisted in reading and writing of the alphabets, getting by heart of multiplication tables and, when the scholars had further advanced, the reading and writing of petitions (Arjis).

facts.claim: In 1855 Dr. Moegling, encouraged by Sir Mark Cubbon, founded an English school at Mercara and appointed Eev G. Richter to run it in May 1856.
facts.quote: In 1855, encouraged by Sir MarkCubbon, Dr. Moegling, the first Protestant Missionary in Coorg, established an English School at Mercara, the charge of which was placed into the hands of the Eev. G. Richter in May 1856

facts.claim: After Head‑sheristadar Nanchappa reconciled to the new order of things, the school began to flourish and gained the favour of the people.
facts.quote: the Head-sheristadar, Nanchappa, having been reconciled to the new order of things, the School began to flourish and gain the favour of the people
